name: a2a-mod
description: A2A protocol client for Claude Code (fork of NovusEdge/a2a-mod).

plugins.name: a2a-mod
plugins.description: A2A for Claude Code: every session serves an A2A endpoint, so Claude sessions and A2A workers hand each other tasks and files. Registered workers and sessions show in ListAgents and take SendMessage as a2a:<alias>; /a2a scan finds them on a private network.
